methods.name: Table 14.1.2: demographics (safety population)
methods.description: Demographics by actual treatment and in total for the safety population: age (n, mean, SD, median, min, max), age group, sex and race (n and %). Build the analysis results data (ARD); the lab draws the table from it.

methods.name: Table 14.1.1: disposition (randomised participants)
methods.description: SCREENED and SCRFAIL (Total only, n); POP (N randomised); TREATED (SAFFL "Y"), COMPLETED, DISC: n and pct; DCSREAS by reason (CATEGORY = reason): n and pct. Every reason in every column, zeros included.

methods.name: Table 14.3.5: extent of exposure (safety population)
methods.description: POP (N); DUR (n, mean, sd, median, min, max of TRTDURD); DURCAT with categories "1-28 days", "29-84 days", "85-182 days", ">182 days" (n, pct); PYEARS est = sum(TRTDURD) / 365.25.

methods.name: Table 14.3.1: treatment-emergent adverse events by system class and preferred term
Table 14.3.4: shift from baseline to Week 26 in laboratory reference range (chemistry)
methods.description: N (CATEGORY = PARAMCD): participants with BNRIND and a Week 26 ANRIND. SHIFT (CATEGORY "<PARAMCD> | <baseline> | <week 26>") for all nine combinations of LOW, NORMAL, HIGH: n and pct of N (NA when N is 0). Groups: the three treatments, no Total.

methods.name: Table 14.3.6: vital signs, change from baseline at Week 26
methods.description: BASE, AVAL, CHG with CATEGORY = PARAMCD: n, mean, sd. Groups: the three treatments.

methods.name: Table 14.3.7: concomitant medications on treatment by drug class and name
methods.description: POP (N), ANY, CLASS (CATEGORY = CMCLAS), DRUG (CATEGORY "<CMCLAS> | <CMDECOD>"): n and pct; participants counted once per row. Groups: three treatments and Total.

methods.name: Table 14.2.1: HbA1c change from baseline at Week 26 (ANCOVA)
methods.description: lm(CHG ~ TRT + BASE) with TRT a factor with placebo as the reference level. LSMEAN est and se: predict() at each treatment with BASE = mean baseline of the analysis set. DIFF est, lcl, ucl, p: the TRT coefficients, confint() and their p-values.

methods.name: Table 14.2.2: HbA1c change from baseline by visit, MMRM (primary estimand)
methods.description: lab_mmrm(CHG ~ TRT * AVISIT + BASE * AVISIT, d, subject = "USUBJID", visit = "AVISIT") on ADLB records with AVISITN > 0 and CHG not missing; TRT a factor with Placebo first, AVISIT a factor with levels 4, 12, 26. N per TRT (participants in the model). For each visit (CATEGORY "WEEK 4", "WEEK 12", "WEEK 26"): LSMEAN est and se for each treatment, at BASE = mean baseline over participants in the model (one value each); DIFF est, lcl, ucl, p for each dose minus placebo.

methods.name: Table 14.2.3: sensitivity analysis, placebo-based multiple imputation
methods.description: One row per ITT participant (sorted by USUBJID): TRT from TRT01PN, BASE = HBA1CBL, CHG at Week 26 or missing. ref <- lm(CHG ~ BASE) on placebo participants with CHG. b, V, s, df: its coefficients, vcov, sigma and residual df. set.seed(20260301) once. For m in 1:50: sm <- s * sqrt(df / rchisq(1, df)); bm <- b + t(chol(V * (sm / s)^2)) %*% rnorm(2); missing CHG <- bm[1] + bm[2] * BASE + rnorm(number missing, 0, sm), in row order; then lm(CHG ~ TRT + BASE) and keep each dose's estimate and squared SE. Q = mean of estimates; W = mean of variances; B = variance of estimates; T = W + (1 + 1/M) B; df = (M - 1)(1 + W / ((1 + 1/M) B))^2. DIFF est, se = sqrt(T), lcl, ucl (t quantile with df), p, df. Also N, NMISS, M in the Total group.

methods.name: Table 14.3.8: time to first treatment-emergent adverse event
methods.description: Product-limit estimate at each event time, Greenwood variance. Median: first event time where S <= 0.5. 95% CI for the median: first event times where the upper and lower log(-log) pointwise limits fall to 0.5 or below (Brookmeyer-Crowley); NA if never. lab_cox(AVAL, 1 - CNSR, cbind(D5, D10)) with indicator variables for the 5 mg and 10 mg groups (Breslow ties). HR hr, lcl, ucl, p for each dose. Three-group test: observed minus expected events and their covariance summed over event times; chi-square with 2 degrees of freedom. LOGRANK chisq and p in the Total group.
